reserveReview.rationale: Alto documents that mint markets create DUSD while borrow markets redistribute existing DUSD. The issuer snapshot generated 2026-09-21T08:26:01.517Z identifies six active mint markets: 29,199.244174390580748277 DUSD debt against frxUSD, 45,546.697477714521278426 against wstETH, 21,249.118041602837222592 against WETH, 1,506.646068724443642677 against rETH, 2.004116624530663769 against sUSDe, and 2.005222443075895947 against syrupUSDC. Ethereum block 26024703, timestamp 2026-09-21T08:29:35Z, returned 722,604.611770924639631386 frxUSD from balanceOf(0x1bd08b43d1579881cfad0a35aeea5b547dbe4c91) on frxUSD 0xCAcd6fd266aF91b8AeD52aCCc382b4e165586E29. Normalizing the USM balance plus mint-market debt gives the issuance-path allocation shown here; the frxUSD slice includes both the USM and the new frxUSD mint market. Percentages are rounded to eight decimals, with the rounding residual assigned to the largest slice. These weights describe backing paths, not market-valued collateral coverage or a liability reconciliation; the API and RPC observations are about four minutes apart.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer API active mint-market nominal DUSD debt plus the on-chain USM frxUSD balance observed on 2026-09-21
